title: CYBRIK investigation claim v1
description: A single claim asserted (or abstained) within an investigation. The claim's `statement`/`confidence` are UNTRUSTED, advisory analyst-support content — never an authorization or action trigger (same TR-6 stance as the accepted W2-D inference packet's summary_text). An 'asserted' claim MUST cite at least one grounding evidence_refs entry (roadmap Week 2: 'Claim/evidence validator, citation dereference và digest'); an 'abstained' claim MUST instead record why (roadmap Week 2: 'Abstention/missing-evidence output') and MUST NOT carry a confidence level. Claims carry NO tool/capability/delegation/approval/action field — asserting or abstaining is descriptive output, never itself an execution-authority grant (disjoint from ADR-0004). Status: ACCEPTED FOR IMPLEMENTATION (v0.1.0; not stable v1/GA) by explicit Founder Option A and G-W0I01-1..5=yes on 2026-07-26.

claim_digest.description: Content digest of this claim record itself. This is the digest a bundle's claims[] cites (structural replay anchor).

investigation_id.description: Parent cybrik.investigation.v1.investigation_id. Required — a claim is always investigation-scoped (ADR-0006 E6).

statement.description: What is being claimed, or — when status='abstained' — what could not be determined and why it matters. Untrusted advisory text.

confidence.description: Required when status='asserted'; MUST be absent when status='abstained' (see allOf).

evidence_refs.description: Digest-bound references to cybrik.evidence.v1 entries grounding this claim (digest here == that evidence's evidence_digest, not its source_ref.digest). Referenced, not inlined — the platform dereferences through the owner's authorized evidence store. Required to be non-empty when status='asserted' (see allOf); a runtime invariant (schema cannot express it) additionally requires every digest here to match a real evidence_digest at the same investigation_id (citation dereference — roadmap Week 2).

produced_by.description: Authenticated actor (typically an agent) that produced the claim. Written only by authenticated service code; a model can never self-assert this identity.
